verdict.rationale: Temporal has a first-class Schedules feature (and legacy Cron Jobs) explicitly documented for starting Workflow Executions at specific times, with recurring/repeated execution, retries, and durable state, plus CLI/UI/Web tooling to manage them — directly enabling scheduled/recurring AI workflows (e.g., agent loops per temporal-docs-9/25/33). missing for 10: independent hands-on validation specifically of the Schedules feature (community evidence is about general durability, not scheduling specifically).
